title: Reconcile Codex --cd sandbox vs canonical Runtime/runs/ path AND cross-run delivered_dedupe_keys.txt sandbox-write blockage
description: Created 2026-05-06 by ep.20260506T060000Z. Scope expanded 2026-05-06 by ep.20260506T083000Z to cover the parallel delivered_dedupe_keys.txt sandbox-write issue (same root cause; surfaced during the post-decouple PATH A re-validation). Structural cause: Codex `codex exec --cd .runs/<id>` makes the agent's cwd during the autonomous run be the per-run sandbox subdir, with two consequences: (1) per-run artifacts (collected.json, stripped.txt, shortlist.json, briefings/, output.md) land at `.runs/<id>/Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/` not the canonical workdir-root `Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/` referenced by AGENTS.md and the SKILL.md files; (2) cross-run state writes to `Runtime/runs/delivered_dedupe_keys.txt` (at the repo root) are sandbox-blocked, so the autonomous agent falls back to writing `delivered_dedupe_keys_to_append.txt` inside the per-run dir, which is then orphaned. Decoupling to /home/ubuntu/agents/ai-informer/ confirmed this is structural, not environmental. Recommended fix: add a `run-once.sh` post-processing step that (a) finalizes per-run artifacts from `.runs/<id>/Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/` to canonical `Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/` (via mv or symlink with idempotency), and (b) appends each run's `delivered_dedupe_keys_to_append.txt` to the canonical cross-run `Runtime/runs/delivered_dedupe_keys.txt`. Alternative: change Codex SDK `--cd` target to repo root if the SDK exposes that without breaking per-run isolation. Reference: Memory/episodes/2026/05/ep--20260506T060000Z--build--ai-informer-path-a-validation-cron-install-and-completion-audit.md and ep.20260506T083000Z.

subtasks.text: Investigate whether the Codex SDK / scripts/run-once.sh exposes a way to set --cd to the repo root (instead of .runs/<id>/) without breaking the SDK's per-run isolation.

If no clean SDK option, design a `run-once.sh` post-processing step in /home/ubuntu/agents/ai-informer/scripts/run-once.sh that handles BOTH (a) finalizing per-run artifacts from .runs/<id>/Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/ to canonical Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/, and (b) appending the per-run delivered_dedupe_keys_to_append.txt to canonical Runtime/runs/delivered_dedupe_keys.txt. Ensure idempotency (re-runs of the wrapper must not duplicate appends).
Update AGENTS.md and the three SKILL.md files only if the design's per-run dir convention needs to change; preferred: keep convention, fix wrapper.

Re-run PATH A end-to-end validation in /home/ubuntu/agents/builders/ai-informer-builder/ai-informer/ (note: relocated from /home/ubuntu/agents/ai-informer/ in ep.20260506T143000Z); verify (a) artifacts land at repo-root Runtime/runs/<NN>/<TS>/ as the design specifies, (b) delivered_dedupe_keys.txt has the new run's keys appended.
